newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed in quiet trade.

text.p: Trade on the Istanbul gold exchange slumped on Wednesday to 881 kg from Tuesday's 1,942 kg on lack of physical demand and uncertainty over market direction, dealers said.

Gold closed little changed, falling in dollar terms to $328.50 an ounce from $328.95 following world trends, but firming in lira terms to 1,687,500 lira per gram versus 1,682,000 as the lira eased against the dollar.
"Physical demand was quiet today, while uncertainty over price direction abroad led to traders being sidelined from the market," one dealer said.
The Turkish lira fell to 159,600 to the dollar compared to Tuesday's close of 159,100, accounting for gold's rise in lira terms.
Almost of all of the day's trade -- 821 kg -- took place in the morning session, with 53.3 percent conducted in dollar terms.
